definitions.proxy_gain: proxy_mean (immediate rating, all validation prompts) minus step 0
definitions.sqrt_kl: sqrt of the mean logged per-token KL over the 25 steps up to each evaluation
definitions.reading: linear interpolation at the first evaluation reaching the threshold
definitions.condition_ci: 95% percentile bootstrap over runs that reached the threshold
definitions.bon: expected Best-of-N pick (ties averaged) against a single random sample
